root_cause_analysis.symptom: AgentInput status bar shows no `N% left` text for picker='default' or picker='sonnet' Claude sessions, even with alwaysShowContextSize=true.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Two distinct L4 logic gaps not addressed by Cycle 1's L3 lookup-table fix: (1) For picker='default' on Claude, `resolvedModelKey` falls through to `metadata.currentModelCode`, but the Claude code path of happy-cli (packages/happy-cli/src/claude/**) never writes that field — it is set only by the ACP/Codex/Gemini path (sessionConfigMetadata.ts:113). So `getModelContextWindow(null)===200_000` regardless of the underlying model. (2) The conditional render guard at AgentInput.tsx:365, `props.usageData?.contextSize ? getContextWarning(...) : null`, treats `contextSize=0` as falsy and hides the indicator — even when alwaysShowContextSize=true and usageData is present.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 0ba2ddfc — feat: cycle 1 (14 pipelines) + close-remediation (introduced the partial fix; the gap is what Cycle 1 did NOT address)
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Cycle 1 BA spec correctly identified the L3 hardcoded denominator and replaced it with a per-model lookup. The lookup logic is sound for keys it can match. The plumbing assumption — that picker='default' would fall through to a populated `metadata.currentModelCode` — was never verified, and the truthy-vs-presence guard subtlety was overlooked.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Cycle 5 user audit shows the symptom persists: BOTH 'default' and 'sonnet 4.6' fail to render the indicator on real sessions. The existing fix is necessary but insufficient.

component_chain.role: useSessionSettings hook reads `useSessionUsage(sessionId)` (live latestUsage) and `useSetting('alwaysShowContextSize')`; passes both to AgentInput via props.
resolveUsageData(settings.usage, session.latestUsage) merges live ephemeral and persisted usage into one object passed as `usageData` prop.
ComposerInput renders <AgentInput usageData={usage} alwaysShowContextSize={settings.showCtx} ...> — wires both into AgentInput props.
Call site: computes resolvedModelKey, calls getModelContextWindow, applies truthy guard `usageData?.contextSize ?...:null`. THIS is the fix point.

component_chain.role: getModelContextWindow(modelKey): returns 1_000_000 if key matches /1m$/i etc, else 200_000. Cannot recognise raw Claude IDs like `claude-opus-4-20250514`.

component_chain.role: getContextWarning(contextSize, alwaysShow, theme, maxContextSize=200_000): computes percentage; returns `null` if `remaining > 10 && !alwaysShow`. With alwaysShow=true returns object always.
Render branch: `{contextWarning && (...)}` displays `N% left`. If contextWarning is null (from line 365 truthy guard OR line 303 fall-through), branch is skipped — no DOM emitted.
ONLY writer of metadata.currentModelCode in the entire CLI. Runs in ACP path (Codex/Gemini), NOT Claude. Establishes that for Claude sessions, currentModelCode is always undefined.
